item.text: I’ll build a single solid from the four views, then compare its renders with the reference and refine the proportions.

The first model is built with a base plate, four mounting holes, and two parallel fins. I’m checking the fin direction and spacing against all four views. [Open the CAD viewer](http://127.0.0.1:8775/#part.FCStd).
The comparison shows the fins run along Y and are offset toward one edge of the base. I’m adjusting their length, spacing, and thickness to better match the reference.
The model is a valid single solid with four through-holes and two fins. The best four-view silhouette comparison is about 0.835 IoU. I’m exporting the STEP file now.
